hints.title: Token Expiration Key-Value Storage
hints.text: Store each token and its corresponding expiration timestamp in an associative dictionary.

hints.title: Verifying Expiration Before Renewal
hints.text: during renewal, check if the token exists and its expiration time is strictly greater than the current time.

hints.title: Counting Active Sessions
hints.text: when counting unexpired tokens, iterate through the hash map or filter values where expiration exceeds current time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) generate and renew, O(T) count
complexity.notes: Hash map maps token string to integer expiry timestamp.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining an unsorted list without token indexing makes lookup and renewal quadratic in the number of tokens.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map gives O(1) generate and renew, with O(T) count where T is active token count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly implement hash map storage and understand how expiry conditions operate.
